articles.text_snippet: PepsiCo (NasdaqGS:PEP) outlined a broad efficiency plan that trims its product portfolio and targets higher operational margins. The company signed a new 10 year beverage and snacks partnership with Hyatt Hotels, covering more than 700 U.S. properties. Management tied these moves to ongoing sustainability commitments and continued focus on Frito Lay as a key growth platform. The new efficiency plan and Hyatt partnership tell only part of the PepsiCo story investors need to think through...
articles.title: Does PepsiCo (PEP) Change Its Long Term Case With Its Efficiency Reset?
